title: Ash Tree
body:
Description

The Ash Tree takes on a unique appearance, having an irregularly shaped, burnt-black trunk and no leaves.

The tree appears pitch black while in the cave, but is actually a bit brighter than refined blackstone. The tree can be used in schematics like every other material in-game. Its logs are ideal for use in builds that involve ash or dark materials.

The Ash Tree, same as Magma Tree, can be found inside the Magma Cave and at a Meteor Crash. Additionally, any tree can be turned into an Ash Tree if a player ignites one using the Flamethrower, however, these trees sell for the same price as the original tree it came from.

Trivia

  • The Deadwood tree is called 'AshTree' when used in a schematic, but is in fact a completely different tree and should not be confused with the true Ash tree.
